meta.title: 1com Developers
meta.description: API reference, guides and a Playground for 1com VoIP APIs.

prototype.banner: Prototype sample content. The endpoints on this page are fictional and do not describe a real 1com API.
prototype.untranslated: This content is not translated yet. It is shown in English.

home.title: Build on 1com voice infrastructure
home.lead: Reference documentation, guides and a Playground for the 1com VoIP APIs.
home.referenceBody: Every endpoint with parameters, responses, errors and copyable requests.
home.guidesBody: Task-focused walkthroughs, from your first request to handling errors.
home.playgroundBody: Send requests in Demo mode with synthetic data, or in Live mode against your tenant.

endpoint.deprecatedBanner: This endpoint is deprecated and will be removed on {date}.
endpoint.methodInferredNote: The source never states the HTTP method for this operation; it is inferred from its request examples.
endpoint.authInQuery: Sent as the `{parameter}` query parameter. Because it travels in the URL, keep it out of logs, browser history and client-side code.
endpoint.fixedParamsHelp: These query parameters select this operation. They are always sent with this fixed value.
endpoint.notVerified: Not verified against a live API
endpoint.testedNotVerified: Tested against the live API (one tenant); not fully verified

playground.title: Playground
playground.demoText: Synthetic data. No real requests are sent.
playground.switchConfirmBody: Live requests reach your real tenant and need an API key. Your Demo request and response are cleared.
playground.switchConfirmDemoBody: Your API key is removed from this page and the Live response is cleared.
playground.liveUnavailable: Live requests aren't available for this endpoint in this deployment yet.

portalError.live_disabled: Live requests are disabled for this deployment.
portalError.forbidden_origin: The request was blocked because it did not come from this page.
portalError.unsupported_media_type: The portal rejected the request format. This is a portal bug — please report it.
portalError.payload_too_large: The request was too large to send.
portalError.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
portalError.invalid_request: The request did not pass validation. Check the fields and try again.
portalError.endpoint_not_allowed: This endpoint is not enabled for Live requests yet.
portalError.missing_credential: Enter your API key before sending a Live request.
portalError.upstream_timeout: The 1com server did not respond in time.
portalError.upstream_too_large: The 1com server's response was larger than the portal allows.
portalError.upstream_redirect: The 1com server tried to redirect the request. The portal does not follow redirects.
portalError.upstream_unreachable: The portal could not reach the 1com server.
portalError.portal_unreachable: Could not reach the portal. Check your connection and try again.
portalError.invalid_portal_response: The portal returned an unexpected response.

playground.apiKeyHelp: Kept in this tab's session storage only, cleared when you switch to Demo or close the tab. Sent only to this portal's Live proxy; never logged.
playground.emptyBody: Fill in the request and select Send request to see the response here.
playground.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields before sending.
playground.prototypeNote: Demo responses in this prototype come from the synthetic sample content.
playground.demoUnavailableNote: Demo data for this endpoint isn't available yet (planned for a later phase).
playground.demoUnavailableBody: Demo mode for this endpoint is built in a later phase. It will never replay real observed responses shown elsewhere on this page.
playground.redactedCount: {count, plural, one {# credential-like value was} other {# credential-like values were}} redacted by the portal and never left the server.
playground.redactedWithheld: The portal withheld this response: it contains a credential-like field that couldn't be redacted safely.
playground.fieldsOmitted: The portal shows only documented fields. {count, plural, one {# other field} other {# other fields}} in the upstream record {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} removed on the server.
